info.title: MED1.UZ — Unified API Platform
info.description:
Single REST API for MED-ALL AI: mobile app (Flutter Android/iOS), web platform, HAMBI, Telegram bot and external partners.

## Authentication
Send your API key as `x-api-key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Keys are issued from the Super-Admin API Management Center.

## HMAC request signing (optional, per partner)
Partners with `require_hmac=true` MUST sign every request:
  * `x-timestamp`: unix seconds
  * `x-signature`: hex `HMAC-SHA256(hmac_secret, `${timestamp}.${METHOD}.${path}.${sha256(rawBody)}`)`
Timestamp tolerance is ±300 seconds. Every HMAC event is written to `audit_logs`.

## Sandbox
Keys marked `is_sandbox=true` return deterministic mock data (users, clinics, payments, AI replies) — safe for CI, demos and app-store review.

## Rate limits
Per-key: 60 req/min, 10 000 req/day by default. Overridable per partner tier.

## Response envelope
```json
{"success": true, "data": {...}, "request_id": "req_..."}
```
Errors: `{"success":false, "error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}, "request_id":"req_..."}`.
